test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22nd November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who among the following is the author of the book 'Every Vote Counts - The Story of India's Election'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Naveen Chawla.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The book titled **“Every Vote Counts-The Story of India’s Elections” **has been **authored by former Chief Election Commissioner Navin Chawla.**
 
• It was **launched by the former Vice President of India, Hamid Ansari** in New Delhi.
 
• This book is about** how electoral machinery works** in India.
 
• The book is **published by HarperCollins India.**
 
• Every Vote Counts is a **fascinating, informative account that gives us a kaleidoscopic view** of how the electoral machinery works in the world's largest democracy.

 [IMAGE: https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/51Dn+af0XeL.jpg]
